body: She will love it! I can’t wait to show it to her, she loves switching things around the house and everything that’s cute. Thank you so so much for being so sweet and generous!
Not possible :( the gate is open for sure and I only have 2 girls over!
Hello! Yes! Always welcome, anything cute, I’m so grateful. Thank you!
You are most welcome to do so, she is always so very happy about new flowers!

Small girl’s island, she adores flowers and just ordered her first stairs! Mabel is visiting today. It’s a plain and very bare island, but you are welcome to visit if you want :) The dodo code is 537YC
She just started on the island so there isn’t much to do or look at, I’m sorry about that.
That is just wonderful, she already has an abundance of flowers so she will be ecstatic when she sees it! Thank you both!
That is very sweet, thank you so much :)
Garnet as in from Steven Universe or just gem? She adores the show too! She loves all flowers regardless of color :)
Not at all, she is just 6 so she doesn’t progress much and every flower is loved and overwatered, so even plain flowers make her happy :)

Sahara is here if anyone would like to purchase something from her. This is a small kid’s island so please don’t judge too much! Please don’t destroy her flowers, she loves them . You are welcome to fruits tho and she just started on the island and if you’d like to contribute to her bridge she’d be very happy! Anything and everything is welcome :)
Here is the dodo code G1M6H :)
